title: Sunan Abi Dawud
author: abu-dawud
attributionNote: The compiler selected, arranged and in places commented on the reports; the reports themselves are attributed within each text to their transmitters. The catalogue distinguishes the compiler's work from the material compiled.
description: Abu Dawud al-Sijistani's collection of reports bearing on law and worship, selected for legal content rather than for the fullest possible coverage. It is the fourth of the six collections Sunni tradition counts as canonical.
historicalContext: Compiled in Basra and Baghdad in the late ninth century. Abu Dawud says he gathered reports whose legal bearing was disputed as well as those that were agreed, which is why the collection includes material later critics graded weak.
availabilityNote: Streamed section by section from the Hadith API at read time, Arabic beside the English translation. The host does not identify the translator of this English text. Its rights are therefore unverified; the library streams the text with attribution to the host and does not relicense it.
